messages:
nina: Heads-up: several pilots asked for a compact Console view that shows errors, cost impact, and a simple 'why' pointer (recent deploys, top traces). I'm proposing an MVP called 'Error-Cost Compass' — small scope so we can ship fast. Thoughts?
omar: Love the name. Recommend three launch surfaces: 1) single-pane dashboard (route+tenant filter), 2) alert that correlates error spikes with cost slow burn, 3) nightly export/CSV for billing ops.
jyoti: For customers, CSV + an automatic "why" card (recent deploys, config changes) is high value. Can we get deploy metadata from the runtime? Also they want per-tenant sampling controls.
ben: Runtime can tag spans with deploy_id, route, model_version. We should keep tracing changes minimal: add span-level annotations, not full span dumps. Sampling: default 0.5%, ramp to 5% on anomaly, retention 7 days. Perf impact negligible if only annotations flow to telemetry.
claire: Draft ACs for MVP: (A) Dashboard shows top 20 routes by error delta w/ cost delta column (24h vs 6h) and tenant filter. (B) Correlation alert: error rate > 2.5x baseline AND cost_growth >= 4% in 30m -> create alert with links. (C) Export: per-tenant CSV of top error routes + cost delta. (D) "Why" card surfaces last 5 deploys touching the route and top stack frames from sampled traces.
nina: Implementation notes: keep ingestion schema additive. Minimal new storage: store aggregated counters + sampled trace metadata (trace_id, deploy_id, short stack fingerprint). No full-span rehydration at launch.
omar: Rollout plan: feature flag 'error_cost_compass' -> 5% tenants for 24h smoke, then 25% for 72h, then GA. Canary should also run with alerting disabled by default for the first 48h.
jyoti: Customers requesting per-tenant retention knob; can we expose a per-tenant toggle in the Console? Maybe post-GA. For MVP let's give org-level knob via feature flags.
ben: Work estimates (rough): tracing annotations PR (2w), ingestion + schema + aggregation (1w), dashboard + CSV export (1w), alerting + ticket glue (0.5w), deploy + rollout automation (0.5w). Parallelize where possible; total ~4 weeks elapsed.
claire: Tradeoffs: no deep forensic flows, no long-term trace retention, limited sampling. That keeps cost and complexity down while solving most customer asks.
nina: UX ask: need a compact "why" card UI and a CSV schema. @jyoti can you draft a 1-pager?
jyoti: I will - will include a sample CSV and a wireframe tomorrow.
flag-bot: flag-bot: Created feature flag 'error_cost_compass' in ff-service. Remember to add rollout steps to the RFC.
ben: Also adding fallback: if traces missing, surface recent request table rows and logs snippet (first 3 lines).
nina: OK next steps: I'll author RFC with ACs, rollout plan, and ticket list. Schedule 30m review Thursday 9am. If no blockers we'll kick tickets.
omar: Thanks all.
claire: Adding customer ask doc to RFC.
ben: I'll open the tracing PR draft and link it in RFC.
nina: Closing thread for now.
